> summary(cross)
    Backcross

And I'm having this error with the scantwo function:

Error in rep(0, n.ind * n.pos * (n.pos - 1)/2 * n.gen^2) : 
  invalid 'times' argument
In addition: Warning message:
In calc.pairprob(subset(cross, chr = thechr[i]), stp, oe, err, mf,  :

scanone functions works ok, any insight?

Thank you very much

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] scantwo function error
parts:
You have too many markers to be able to run scantwo. There's not enough memory to store some of the intermediate calculations that are needed.

karl

messages.author: acb750e476c0ff5d
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] scantwo function error
parts:
I had the same scantwo problem when using GigaMUGA data on 96 samples. I had the marker set down to ~31,000 informative markers, but it still didn't work. I did manage to get it working with ~25,000 markers. It worked fine for 1,000 5,000 and 15,000 as well, but not for 31,000 29,000 and 27,000. You may need to try different marker set sizes like I did. I used the pickMarkerSubset function to try different marker set sizes.
Bill
